Event List - Analytic Added Inf_Lib. Replaced TND with JMP. Initialize on First Scan. ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- The List Analytic instruction is designed to monitor an event queue and generate a list of events. As events appear in the queue, the List Analytic instruction monitors event data and determines if each event should be added to the list based on the enumerated configuration of Cfg_Type. New events are added to the output array will be added at array location [0], with the oldest event located at array location ‘n’. Events remain in sequence of newest to oldest, and events at location ‘n’ will be dropped from the array as new data is added. Should the event already be in the list, it is moved to the top of the list, provided a new timestamp, and provided an additional count. Thus, if ‘EventA’ is added found in the queue 17 times, it will appear in the output array once, with an attached count of 17.
--Events that match the Cfg_Type value are added to the output array, events not matching will be ignored. --Output array size is independent of the source queue.
Output Array Data Management: The ‘List Analytic’ instruction is designed to evaluate the output array prior to adding events matching the configured type to determine if the event exists in the array. This is done based on the event message itself.
IF – Event message IS NOT found in the output array --The instruction places data in the output array sequentially as events are processed, with the most recent event placed at array location [0] and oldest event at array location ‘n’. --A count of one is attached to the event IF – Event message IS found in the output array --The instruction moves the existing entry to the top of the array (location [0]) and attaches the new timestamp. All other events are shifted accordingly, with the oldest event remaining at array location ‘n’. --A count of one is added to the current count.
